title: Baked Zucchini with Tomato & Cheese
description: Zucchini halves brushed with olive oil and garlic, topped with sliced tomato and cheese, and baked soft. Finished with fresh basil.

ingredients.note: minced — or ½ tsp garlic powder
or Parmesan, or a mixed blend

steps.heading: Prep
steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Slice the zucchini in half lengthwise and shave a thin slice off the bottom of each half so it sits steady.

steps.heading: Top
steps.text: Brush with olive oil and top with the garlic, then the sliced tomato. Season with salt and pepper and cover with the cheese.

steps.heading: Bake
steps.text: Bake for 20 to 30 minutes, until soft. Scatter with basil to serve.

notes: The original card gives no amounts — these are a starting point for two zucchini.
